reviews.title: Falsely closed my PAID account!!!!!
reviews.text:
“We think someone other than you has been able to access your account using your login credentials, so we've removed the account to keep you and our community safe.”

That was their reply after I reached out to them. Mind you, you would think closing an account would prompt an email informing you of your account's status. I had to email them to get this information. My reply is as follows……

“What made you guys think someone else was using my account? I have had this account for many years & have never once seen any evidence of that! Had I, I would have contacted support. I recently just tried logging in on my old phone last week. Perhaps that is what you're referring to?”

It’s been days, no response. 

This is what happens when you over-rely on an algorithm and don’t have enough human oversight to check what it's doing. Not only do I have a premium membership, but I have also spent my money on additional Super Chispas. So not only do they owe me for my paid membership, but they also owe me for all the money spent on those additional Super Chispas. I had 18 connections going at the time of closure. 

Little, do they know a buddy of mine is a YouTuber in this space with over 1 million subscribers. If they don’t make this right in the coming days, we are going to film a video on this.

I’m extremely disappointed with Chispa. I’m trying to get a $133 refund, but my refund request was denied, and customer service has been extremely difficult to reach.

I deleted my original account and created a new one. I contacted Chispa to ask them to restore my previous purchase on my new account, but they have not responded or provided any real assistance.

On top of that, the app keeps showing me people who are far outside the distance range I selected. I set my preferences to around 20 miles, but I was still being shown people much farther away.

I paid for a service that did not work as expected, and now I can’t even get proper customer support regarding my purchase. Between the $133 refund issue, the inability to restore my purchase, poor customer service, and inaccurate distance preferences, I’m extremely disappointed with Chispa.

I would not recommend spending money on this app.

reviews.title: No customer support for disabled account
reviews.text:
My account was disabled without any warning or explanation, and I have never been told what I supposedly did wrong. I followed Chispa’s instructions and submitted a ban appeal, but never received a response. I submitted it again after waiting weeks and still have received nothing.

I have also contacted customer support multiple times and have been directed back to the appeal form even though I had already completed it. At this point, I have followed every process Chispa has provided and have received absolutely no communication about my account.

I understand that Chispa has rules and that accounts can be banned for legitimate reasons, but users should at least have a functioning appeal process and receive a response when they follow the required procedure. I would simply like to know why my account was disabled and have my appeal actually reviewed.

I was also actively talking to someone I genuinely felt was a great match when my account was suddenly disabled. Because I lost access to the conversation and had no warning that this was going to happen, I also lost the only communication method I had with someone I was getting to know. I may have missed out on a meaningful connection because of an unexplained account action that I have still been unable to get any answers about.

reviews.title: Buggy/Counterproductive
reviews.text: Hiding profile keeps matches but makes your profile look blank to them, so they unmatch. Support article indicates this is how it's supposed to work, even tho pausing a profile on most apps simply prevents new matches. Also terrible that it shows proximity instead of hometown-- this isn't Grindr. That enables stalking, which is very dangerous. Also, can't contact support except through "contact us" button in the app-- which also, predictably, gives an error msg as soon as I tap it. The people I had most interest in unmatched me & I have no way to contact anyone aside from this review. I doubt the Match app has these issues. Please hire a better UX designer and better programmers. This could easily be a 4 or 5 star app, but is more like a 0 or 1 star app b/c of the way it undermines genuine connections. That's why I chose to give it a 2, even tho that feels generous for an app that wasted my time & energy. Do better! We have so few options for dating within our culture w/o being told we're a bigot, so make it worthwhile instead of a lazy money grab.

reviews.title: Bad for no reason
reviews.text:
I downloaded Chispa and used it for less than an hour before the app crashed. When I attempted to log back in, I was informed that my account had been disabled. I immediately contacted customer support and submitted an appeal, but I received only a generic response with no explanation of what policy I supposedly violated.

This is especially frustrating because I had barely used the app. I had not messaged anyone, my photos were recent and authentic, and my profile information was accurate. Despite submitting multiple appeals, I never received a clear explanation or any meaningful assistance.

The lack of transparency and customer support is extremely disappointing. I also have no confirmation that my photos and personal information have been removed from their system. Based on this experience, I cannot recommend this app. There are far better dating apps that treat their users with more respect and provide actual customer service.


Email from customer service
Hello there,
 
We have reviewed your account for a ban appeal and determined that you have violated our Terms and Conditions or Community Guidelines. As a result, your account will remain banned; this decision is final.
 
I understand this is not the outcome you hoped for, but we appreciate your cooperation.
 
Customer Care

reviews.title: MOST ANNOYING APP EVER
reviews.text:
Yes - free to download, but you MUST get the subscription if you want to see who likes your page, read notes, and communicate with anyone. So, sure it’s free if all you want to do is scroll but not actually be able to talk to anyone. 

I caved and got a subscription, I’ve had the app for maybe an hour now it’s so beyond frustrating! I’m getting tons of likes which is nice, but as I’m scrolling through to see who liked my profile, it automatically sends me to the top of the page every time someone new likes my profile. And I accidentally hit the boost option which made the likes come in even more. Over 500 likes and I can’t get past the first 50 people before I get another like and it automatically sends me to the top. All of the new likes must be at the bottom because I keep scrolling through the same people. 
 
Also, the app keeps glitching and closing on its own so every time I go back into the app I have to adjust the settings and start from the top again. Idk why the filter doesn’t stay on… or why the app keeps closing??

reviews.title: There is something fishy here for sure!
reviews.text: I signed up and paid for premium that same night. The next morning I could no longer sign in with my phone number. I contacted customer service, and after a few emails back and forth since it seemed as if they were not understanding the issue and just sending generic emails, they finally sent a generic email stating to fill out some form to appeal a ban. I email back stating my being banned was news to me, again repeating my question that I wanted to make sure I was not going to be charged again since I could not log on to cancel the subscription, but just received some email stating the matter was closed on their end and they would not be responding to any more messages. It was like talking to a wall. Don’t waste your time with this app; read other reviews about the lack of response from customer service and others stating it’s a scam… wish I had read through more reviews before signing up. I will be contacting the BBB  if necessary.
